_doc: Scene types for SceneGen. params override MapGen.DEFAULTS (w/h in squares of 2 m; floors = tallest structure). The planner code lives in src/gen/scene_gen.gd.

street_block.name: Street block
street_block.desc: Two roads, alleys, a mix of buildings of different heights and a parking lot.

megablock.name: Megablock
megablock.desc: Apartment tower over a courtyard, parking and a corner shop.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.desc: Moored cargo ship, quay cranes, fenced container yard, warehouse and gate booth.

badlands.name: Badlands raider camp
badlands.desc: Open desert with rock outcrops, a riverbed, wrecks and a fenced raider camp.

rail_yard.name: Rail yard
rail_yard.desc: Stopped train you can board, freight cars on parallel tracks, platform and station.

corp_campus.name: Corporate campus
corp_campus.desc: Fenced grounds, gate booth, parking, plaza, HQ tower and service building.

city_district.name: City district
city_district.desc: Tech demo: a 4 × 3 grid of city blocks, dozens of buildings, skybridges and footbridges.
